Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a new isolated ghost sprite for a serious dark-fantasy RPG cinematic, portrait 1024x1536, real transparent alpha.
Image 1 is an IDENTITY reference for the existing spirit: a pointed ivory bone mask, hollow eyes with cold blue light, two curling blue flame horns, a spectral blue flame body, long clawed hands and no legs. Image 2 is ONLY the style reference: serious, detailed portrait-quality pixel art with mature proportions, controlled crisp pixel clusters and subtle dramatic shading.
Create a NEW pose of that SAME spirit standing completely UPRIGHT, facing STRAIGHT FORWARD toward the viewer. Full-body frontal view. The skull face, torso and lower spectral tail aligned on one perfectly vertical axis, eyes looking directly forward, head level, shoulders level, both arms descending naturally at its sides and hands/claws clearly visible. Balanced nearly symmetrical silhouette. No twist, lean, tilted head or three-quarter view. Cold commanding presence, long elegant skeletal face, ivory bone mask with pointed chin and dark eye sockets, restrained icy blue eyes. Tall curling spectral horn flames at top, flowing long blue flame tendrils around a thin humanoid torso, spectral tail tapering straight downward instead of feet. Keep the face large enough to read, in the TOP quarter of the sprite, and clearly separate the head from the horns.
Style: polished serious pixel art matching the dialogue portrait reference, detailed form and mature eerie anatomy, limited deep navy/muted cobalt/steel-blue palette with pale ivory face and crisp blue rim highlights; no cute or cartoon proportions. This will briefly appear behind a throne as an ominous silhouette, so maintain a strong upright readable outline.
Composition: one spirit centered, the ENTIRE silhouette including horn tips, both hands and tail INSIDE the canvas with 6% empty transparent margin on all sides. No scene, ground, throne, king, halo, lightning, text, logo, panel, border or UI. Genuinely transparent background, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no shadow or rectangular matte.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated LIGHTNING animation sprite, FRAME A, for a serious dark-fantasy pixel-art game cinematic. One tall jagged branching bolt of lightning on REAL TRANSPARENT alpha. Portrait canvas 1024x1536.
A single main narrow white-hot lightning channel begins at x=50%, y=7%, descends mostly vertically with many short irregular angular zigzags, and finishes around x=44%, y=93%. A few thin natural branching forks reach left and right, all inside the middle 65% of canvas width. Asymmetrical organic fractal branching, no regular sawtooth or geometric polygon. Tight pale electric blue and muted blue-violet rim around the ivory-white core; crisp stepped pixels and subtle dithering appropriate to detailed serious RPG dialogue art. Compact luminous edge, fully transparent surrounding space, no broad diffuse cloud or background glow. The primary channel remains slender (roughly 1-2% of image width); small forks thinner.
One complete full-length bolt centered with at least 6% clear transparent padding at all edges, no cropping. This is one frame of a two-frame lightning animation, NOT a sprite sheet. Pure effect asset: no people, spirit, scenery, clouds, rain, ground, text, UI, border or watermark. No fake checkerboard background. Real alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated LIGHTNING animation sprite, FRAME B, for a serious dark-fantasy pixel-art game cinematic. One tall jagged branching bolt of lightning on REAL TRANSPARENT alpha. Portrait canvas 1024x1536.
Same visual specification as the companion frame: narrow ivory-white channel with tight pale electric blue and muted blue-violet rim, crisp stepped pixel-art edges, subtle dithering, compact glow, no diffuse background. The main channel starts at x=50%, y=7% and ends near x=55%, y=93%, but its irregular zigzag path and fork pattern must DIFFER clearly from frame A: curve the middle section toward the RIGHT before returning near center, with a long thin fork to the upper LEFT and two shorter forks in the lower right. Organic lightning branching with several short unequal bends, no smooth sine wave, no geometric diamond or repeating sawtooth. Main channel slender, around 1-2% of canvas width, smaller forks thinner. Keep all channels inside the middle 65% of width.
Exactly one full-length centered bolt with at least 6% empty transparent padding at all edges. Real transparent alpha, no black rectangle or baked checkerboard. One standalone animation frame, not a sprite sheet. No people, ghost, scenery, storm cloud, rain, ground, text, UI, border or watermark.
